title: openai-chat-completions-parity-params-roles-stop-logprobs-formatting-streaming
author: Ava Martinez
description: Bring Redwood's /v1/chat.completions compatibility to full parity for request params, role handling, stop tokens/logprobs surface, response formatting, and streaming stability when tool/function calls and structured outputs are requested. Motivation: customers report minor incompatibilities with OpenAI's chat completions shape (params names, role normalization, stop sequences, and logprobs attachment) causing SDK users to need adapter code and failing some third-party eval pipelines. This PR implements: 1) parameter mapping layer: accept OpenAI-style params (max_tokens, temperature, top_p, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty) and normalize to internal config; preserve deprecated/alias keys; 2) role normalization: ensure system/user/assistant roles are mapped and preserve assistant->tool role when function/tool calls are returned; 3) stop token handling: support list and string stop params and enforce earliest stop behavior identical to OpenAI across streaming and non-streaming paths; 4) logprobs: attach token-level logprobs for 'logprobs' requests and include per-choice top_logprobs when available; 5) response formatting: keep content/finish_reason semantics identical (stop/length/function_call) and include 'message' vs. 'text' fallbacks for downstream clients; 6) streaming stability improvements: stabilize chunking when function/tool calls and structured outputs are emitted (fixes partial JSON chunks causing client-side JSON.parse failures). The implementation adds a compatibility layer at the API gateway, adjusts runtime handlers to emit unified stream events, and contains tests and integration fixtures for common OpenAI SDKs. Rollout plan: feature-gate behind compat.openai_chat_completions=true for immediate rollout to canary, followed by global enable after 48h monitoring. See linked Linear tickets ENG-1934 ENG-1987 and PM-482 for product acceptance criteria.

release_notes: Add OpenAI /v1/chat.completions compatibility: support OpenAI-style params, role normalization, stop token semantics, logprobs attachment, and streaming stability fixes for structured outputs and function/tool calls. Feature gated; enable in canary then global rollout.
notes: Backcompat: alias params accepted (e.g., max_tokens -> max_output_tokens) to reduce migration friction.
Perf: requesting logprobs increases compute and storage; documented in docs/openai_compat.md.
Monitoring: added metrics compat.openai_chat.started and compat.openai_chat.errors to track adoption and issues during canary rollout.
